decisions.reason: Box trailers are central to the firm's established trailer business and likely still meet aspiration levels, so there is no trigger for problemistic search despite the lack of recent website evidence.
The low-bed series draws on core production know-how and serves professional users, and the strong post-2020 demand for trailers gives enough slack to keep it.
High-cover trailers complement the core range and share production and distribution resources, so keeping them is low-cost while results remain acceptable.
This second box trailer series overlaps with B, which makes it the likeliest candidate for consolidation, but without evidence of a shortfall management keeps it for now.
